legend: Vasya's house is situated in a forest, and there is a mushroom glade near it. The glade consists of two rows, each of which can be divided into n consecutive cells. For each cell Vasya knows how fast the mushrooms grow in this cell (more formally, how many grams of mushrooms grow in this cell each minute). Vasya spends exactly one minute to move to some adjacent cell. Vasya cannot leave the glade. Two cells are considered adjacent if they share a common side. When Vasya enters some cell, he instantly collects all the mushrooms growing there.

Vasya begins his journey in the left upper cell. Every minute Vasya must move to some adjacent cell, he cannot wait for the mushrooms to grow. He wants to visit all the cells exactly once and maximize the total weight of the collected mushrooms. Initially, all mushrooms have a weight of 0. Note that Vasya doesn't need to return to the starting cell.
Help Vasya! Calculate the maximum total weight of mushrooms he can collect.
input: The first line contains the number n (1 ≤ n ≤ 3·105) — the length of the glade.
The second line contains n numbers a1, a2, ..., an (1 ≤ ai ≤ 106) — the growth rate of mushrooms in the first row of the glade.
The third line contains n numbers b1, b2, ..., bn (1 ≤ bi ≤ 106) is the growth rate of mushrooms in the second row of the glade.
output: Output one number — the maximum total weight of mushrooms that Vasya can collect by choosing the optimal route. Pay attention that Vasya must visit every cell of the glade exactly once.

legend.ai: Vasya 的房子坐落在一片森林中，房子附近有一片蘑菇空地。这片空地由两行组成，每行可以划分为 n 个连续的单元格。对于每个单元格，Vasya 知道蘑菇在该单元格中的生长速度（更正式地说，即每分钟在该单元格中生长的蘑菇克数）。Vasya 移动到某个相邻单元格恰好需要一分钟。Vasya 不能离开这片空地。如果两个单元格有公共边，则称它们相邻。当 Vasya 进入某个单元格时，他会立即收集那里生长的所有蘑菇。
Vasya 从左上角的单元格开始他的旅程。每分钟 Vasya 都必须移动到某个相邻单元格，不能等待蘑菇生长。他希望恰好访问每个单元格一次，并使收集到的蘑菇总重量最大。初始时，所有蘑菇的重量均为 0。注意，Vasya 不需要返回起始单元格。
请帮助 Vasya！计算他能够收集到的蘑菇总重量的最大值。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 3·105）——蘑菇空地的长度。
第二行包含 n 个数 a1, a2, ..., an（1 ≤ ai ≤ 106），表示空地第一行蘑菇的生长速度。
第三行包含 n 个数 b1, b2, ..., bn（1 ≤ bi ≤ 106），表示空地第二行蘑菇的生长速度。

output.ai: 输出一个数，表示 Vasya 通过选择最优路线能够收集到的蘑菇总重量的最大值。注意，Vasya 必须恰好访问空地中的每个单元格一次。
